en_title: God of War Ragnarok Tops List of 10 Highest-Grossing PlayStation Studios Games From the PS5 Generation
cn_title: 《战神：诸神黄昏》位居PS5世代10款收入最高的PlayStation Studios游戏榜首
opus_summary: Alinea Analytics估计，《战神：诸神黄昏》以14亿美元(约合人民币94亿元)收入位居PS5世代PlayStation Studios游戏榜首，《蜘蛛侠2》和《跑车浪漫旅7》分列二、三位。榜单前十款游戏在PlayStation、Steam和XBOX平台合计收入超过65亿美元(约合人民币434亿元)。

paragraphs.en: Sony Santa Monica Studios' God of War Ragnarok tops the list of highest-grossing PlayStation Studios games of the PS5 generation, according to Alinea Analytics.
paragraphs.cn: 据Alinea Analytics称，索尼Santa Monica Studios的《战神：诸神黄昏》位居PS5世代收入最高的PlayStation Studios游戏榜首。

paragraphs.en: The game data company's head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, shared information related to sales for titles published under the PlayStation banner in a Substack post today. It features a list of 10 games estimated to have emerged as Sony's best performers so far.
paragraphs.cn: 这家游戏数据公司的市场分析主管Rhys Elliott今天在一篇Substack帖子中分享了以PlayStation品牌发行的游戏的相关销售信息。帖子列出了10款游戏，据估计，它们是索尼迄今表现最好的游戏。

paragraphs.en: You can probably guess at least some of the games that managed to crack the top 10 list, but there are a few interesting inclusions in there, too. God of War Ragnarok, for example, is placed at number one with an estimated $1.4 billion in gross revenue. Spider-Man 2 is second at $1.3 billion, with Gran Turismo 7 placed third at $841.9 million. You can see the full list below.
paragraphs.cn: 你或许至少能猜到一些跻身前10名的游戏，但榜单中也有几个有意思的入选作品。例如，《战神：诸神黄昏》以估计14亿美元的总收入位列第一。《蜘蛛侠2》以13亿美元位居第二，《跑车浪漫旅7》以8.419亿美元位列第三。你可以在下方查看完整榜单。

paragraphs.en: Here's the 10 top-grossing PlayStation Studios games of this generation (@alineaanalytics estimates).
paragraphs.cn: 以下是本世代收入最高的10款PlayStation Studios游戏（@alineaanalytics估算）。

paragraphs.en: Together, the 10 games generated over $6.5 billion across PlayStation (84.7%), Steam (14.1%), and Xbox (1.2% via just Helldivers 2).
paragraphs.cn: 这10款游戏在PlayStation（84.7%）、Steam（14.1%）和XBOX（仅凭《绝地潜兵2》占1.2%）上合计创造了超过65亿美元的收入。

paragraphs.en: Full write-up over on Substack. https://t.co/3XLgJdTqUM
paragraphs.cn: 完整文章见Substack。https://t.co/3XLgJdTqUM

paragraphs.en: These 10 games alone have generated $6.5 billion for PlayStation. Although the list only includes titles from the PS5 generation, the numbers here do account for other platforms. Astro Bot, for example, is exclusive to PS5 and earned its amount only through the estimated 4.7 million copies it sold on that platform.
paragraphs.cn: 仅这10款游戏就为PlayStation创造了65亿美元的收入。虽然榜单只包括PS5世代的游戏，但这里的数据确实计入了其他平台。例如，《宇宙机器人》是PS5独占游戏，其收入全部来自该游戏在这一平台上估计售出的470万份。

paragraphs.en: God of War Ragnarok, meanwhile, is also available on PS4 and PC, with Alinea Analytics' breakdown showing its revenue accumulated via 21.6 million copies across all three platforms. Of its performance on PlayStation, 75.2% of its 20.1 million share of copies sold were on PS5, specifically, with 27.5% of all sales on PS4 and PS5 being physical. Elliott called the Norse God of War sequel an evergreen title for Sony, explaining that in 2026 alone it's managed to sell 1.1 million copies. That's an impressive feat compared even to brand-new games from this year, and it's only more impressive when you consider that it was made accessible to PlayStation Extra subscribers nearly two years ago in January of 2025. Alinea Analytics estimates show that 6.7 million PlayStation Plus users have accessed it via the service.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《战神：诸神黄昏》也登陆了PS4和PC，Alinea Analytics的细分数据显示，其收入来自三个平台合计售出的2160万份游戏。在PlayStation上的表现方面，其2010万份销量中，具体有75.2%来自PS5，而PS4和PS5上的总销量中有27.5%为实体版。Elliott称这款以北欧为背景的《战神》续作为索尼的一款长销游戏，并解释说，仅在2026年，该游戏就已售出110万份。即便与今年的全新游戏相比，这也是一项令人印象深刻的成绩；考虑到近两年前的2025年1月，PlayStation Extra订阅用户就已能游玩该作，这一成绩就更令人印象深刻了。Alinea Analytics的估算显示，有670万名PlayStation Plus用户通过该服务游玩过这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Yōtei may have technically been trailing behind its predecessor as of October , but at least for now, its recent Echoes of Sekigahara expansion has helped it land in sixth. As of today's update, it's said to have sold 5.5 million copies as a PS5 exclusive. Another interesting addition from the list is Stellar Blade, which is technically a second-party release published by PlayStation Studios. Today's data accounts for sales across PS5 and Steam (a Nintendo Switch 2 version launched yesterday) and shows that 59.7% of its revenue was earned from the former and 40.3% from the latter.
paragraphs.cn: 截至10月，《Ghost of Yōtei》在技术上可能一直落后于前作，但至少目前，其近期推出的扩展内容《Echoes of Sekigahara》帮助它登上了第六名。截至今天的更新，据称这款PS5独占游戏已售出550万份。榜单上另一款有意思的入选作品是《剑星》，严格来说，它是由PlayStation Studios发行的第二方游戏。今天的数据计入了PS5和Steam平台的销量（Switch 2版本于昨天推出），显示其59.7%的收入来自前者，40.3%来自后者。

paragraphs.en: Alinea Analytics' breakdown is not an official look into where sales are at with Sony's gaming division. Meanwhile, its update follows official information released by the PlayStation company just earlier this week. It came with the news that it had raised its sales forecast while also sharing figures for Marvel's Wolverine for the first time . For more, you can see how PlayStation's Bloodborne has held up in the 11 years since its launch on PS4 .
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics的细分数据并非索尼游戏部门销售状况的官方数据。与此同时，其更新发布于PlayStation公司本周早些时候公布的官方信息之后。该公司当时宣布上调了销售预期，同时首次公布了《漫威金刚狼》的数据。更多内容方面，你可以了解PlayStation的《血源诅咒》自登陆PS4以来的11年间表现如何。
